subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the canonical fix require full paragraph-boundary semantics across in-budget and maxChars split cases, or accept a common-case text-only repair and track overflow boundaries separately?
rationale: Both open candidate pull requests target the right shared boundary, but the exact separator-carrying versus explicit-boundary-metadata shape affects message delivery semantics and needs maintainer selection before consolidation.

options.title: Require full boundary semantics
options.body: Consolidate on a fix that preserves paragraph seams across normal and overflow split cases without exceeding channel limits or doubling separators.

options.title: Accept common-case repair
options.body: Land one candidate for the common paragraph case and track rare overflow boundary behavior as a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Pause current candidates
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers reject the current text-only direction and ask for a fresh design.

recommendation.title: Require full boundary semantics
recommendation.body: Consolidate on a fix that preserves paragraph seams across normal and overflow split cases without exceeding channel limits or doubling separators.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared coalescer and pipeline history make this the best available routing owner for the boundary-semantics decision.
